title: docs(spec): state the notify click-through default in the sourceObject / sourceId / actionUrl describes
body:

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuKB8Sg6c6sVpL96ruVvdxaf)_

Fixes #30689

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`notify` 节点 `sourceObject` / `sourceId` / `actionUrl` 三个字段的 spec 说明文字（及其注释、生成的参考文档页），补上"三者都不写时，通知自动链接到触发本次运行的记录"这条默认行为及其例外。
- 为什么改：运行时早已默认链接到触发记录，但 spec 文档只说"成对生效、缺一半会被丢弃"，元数据作者和 AI 读到的说明与实际行为不一致。
- 风险与回滚：只改说明文字，不改任何键、结构、默认值或校验；回滚即 revert 本 PR，无数据或行为影响。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/automation/io-node-config.zod.ts` 的三个 `.describe()` 与 `NotifyConfigSchema` 文档块；其次 `content/docs/references/automation/io-node-config.mdx` 的生成差异。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`，预期输出 "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date"。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/automation/io-node-config.zod.ts`
  - `sourceObject` and `sourceId` `.describe()`: keep the pair rule (a half-written pair is dropped, now "not defaulted"), and add the default: when `sourceObject`, `sourceId` and `actionUrl` are all left out, a run started by a record (a record change other than a delete, a time-relative sweep, an action on a record) links to that record, a run with no trigger record links nowhere, and an explicit pair or an `actionUrl` is kept as written.
  - `actionUrl` `.describe()`: adds "written alone keeps the notification from linking to the record that started the run". This is the runtime's own sentence from `notify-node.ts`.
  - The JSDoc of the three keys, and a new "Click-through default" bullet in the `NotifyConfigSchema` docblock that names every exception the executor applies: delete events, runs with no trigger record, an explicit pair or `actionUrl`, a half pair.
- `content/docs/references/automation/io-node-config.mdx`: regenerated by `gen:docs`, not edited by hand.
- `.changeset/30689-notify-click-through-default-describe.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch.

No key, shape, default, refinement or export changes. Nothing outside `packages/spec/**` changes, apart from the generated page and the changeset.

**The claims, checked against the runtime on `origin/main` `ab44ec94b`** (`packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/notify-node.ts`, read only):
- `triggerRecordOf` returns a trigger record only when the run context has both `object` and `record.id`.
- `defaultClickThroughOf` returns nothing when any of the three keys is written, and nothing for `beforeDelete` / `afterDelete`.
- The executor uses the explicit pair only when both halves resolve, and otherwise falls back to `defaultClickThroughOf`. So a half pair is dropped and is not defaulted.
- Which runs carry `object` + `record`:
  - record change: yes, through `trigger-record-change`;
  - time-relative sweep: yes (`time-relative-trigger.ts`, `event: 'time_relative'`);
  - action on a record: yes (`action-execution.ts`, which passes `record` and `object`).
- Which runs do not:
  - inbound API post: `trigger-api` passes `record: payload` and no `object`;
  - manual REST start: `buildAutomationContext` sets `object` and no `record`;
  - schedule tick: neither.
- The six tests in `notify-node.test.ts` under "notify click-through defaults to the trigger record" pin each case.

## Tests

All readings below are on head `5c4599568` (`git rev-parse --short HEAD`), worktree off base `ab44ec94b`. Exit codes were captured before any pipe.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` under the verify lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`:
  - before regenerating: exit 1, `content/docs/references/** stale`;
  - after `gen:docs`: exit 0, `All 14 generated artifacts are up to date`.
- The nine `@objectstack/spec` test files that import or cover `io-node-config`, under the lock: `Test Files 9 passed (9)`, `Tests 628 passed (628)`. They include `io-node-config.test.ts`, whose `/dropped at execute time/i` pin still holds.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` (tsc, scripts typecheck, test typecheck): exit 0.
- `npx eslint --no-inline-config packages/spec/src/automation/io-node-config.zod.ts`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base ab44ec94b --event` with an offline PR event that carries this body's two declaration lines: exit 0. Its verdict: "LEVEL AXIS: this PR declares clause-② `no` and metadata-protocol `none` … a non-protocol change at `patch`".
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 96 commands, and every one ran.
  - Five first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: unbuilt `lint`, `formula`, `client-react` and `objectql` dists). A sixth also exited 3 because it needs the full workspace build. After `turbo run build` of those closures, and then the full build, all six re-ran at exit 0.
  - `--ran` reconciliation: `96 derived, 96 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
- Local-only gates: `pnpm check:dev-prereqs` exit 0, `pnpm check:skill-frame-freshness` exit 0, `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs` exit 0.
- No ablation: this diff changes no tested behaviour, only describe text and docs.

## Acceptance notes

- **Pair note in `NOTIFY_KEY_GUIDANCE.source` (≈:137) is left as it is, on purpose.** It says "the pair only takes effect together: a half-specified target is dropped". That is still true under the default. It speaks to an author who is moving a nested `source: { object, id }` onto the flat pair, so it is about a pair that is written, and the default never applies to such a pair. Nothing in it became false or incomplete for that reader.
- **Skill wording:** `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md:124` comments the example as `click-through: a PAIR, else dropped`. That is still true, and it is not the old "only takes effect together" sentence. It does not mention the trigger-record default. Not edited here, because `skills/**` is outside this card's surface.
- **Hand-written docs:** `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx:352` says "a half-specified click-through pair is dropped, as before". That is still true, and the page does not mention the default either. Not edited here: it is outside this card's surface.
- **Not merged with `origin/main`.** The branch is 6 commits behind `447226b22`. Those commits touch `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver*` and `platform-locales*` plus five unrelated changesets, and none of them touches this diff's files. The dispatch-gates derivation says none of them touched what its answer derives from.
